result.topic_en: The page derives recursion and product identities for Euler's continuant brackets (a^0...a^ν), which underlie continued fractions, as used in the Disquisitiones Arithmeticae and the Dioptrische Untersuchungen.
result.transcription:
Der Eulersche Algorithmus
so wie in Disquis. Ar. und Dioptr. Unters.

Jede Formel aus der Verbindung der beiden vorhergehenden
$(a^0\ldots a^{\lambda-1}) = (a^0\ldots a^{\lambda-1})$
$(a^0\ldots a^{\lambda}) = (a^0\ldots a^{\lambda-1})a^{\lambda} + (a^0\ldots a^{\lambda-2})$
$(a^0\ldots a^{\lambda+1}) = (a^0\ldots a^{\lambda-1})(a^{\lambda},a^{\lambda+1}) + (a^0\ldots a^{\lambda-2})a^{\lambda+1}$
$(a^0\ldots a^{\lambda+2}) = (a^0\ldots a^{\lambda-1})(a^{\lambda}\ldots a^{\lambda+2}) + (a^0\ldots a^{\lambda-2})(a^{\lambda+1},a^{\lambda+2})$
u.s.f. Allgemein
$(a^0\ldots a^{\nu}) = (a^0\ldots a^{\lambda-1})(a^{\lambda}\ldots a^{\nu}) + (a^0\ldots a^{\lambda-2})(a^{\lambda+1}\ldots a^{\nu})$

Ferner
$(a^0\ldots a^{\lambda-2})(a^{\lambda}\ldots a^{\nu}) \qquad + (a^0\ldots a^{\lambda-2})(a^{\lambda}\ldots a^{\nu})$
$(a^0\ldots a^{\lambda-1})(a^{\lambda}\ldots a^{\nu}) - (a^0\ldots a^{\nu}) = -(a^0\ldots a^{\lambda-2})(a^{\lambda+1}\ldots a^{\nu})$
$(a^0\ldots a^{\lambda})(a^{\lambda}\ldots a^{\nu}) - (a^0\ldots a^{\nu})a^{\lambda} = +(a^0\ldots a^{\lambda-2})(a^{\lambda+2}\ldots a^{\nu})$
$(a^0\ldots a^{\lambda+1})(a^{\lambda}\ldots a^{\nu}) - (a^0\ldots a^{\nu})(a^{\lambda},a^{\lambda+1}) = -(a^0\ldots a^{\lambda-2})(a^{\lambda+3}\ldots a^{\nu})$
u.s.f. Allgemein
$(a^0\ldots a^{\mu})(a^{\lambda}\ldots a^{\nu}) - (a^0\ldots a^{\nu})(a^{\lambda}\ldots a^{\mu}) = \pm(a^0\ldots a^{\lambda-2})(a^{\mu+2}\ldots a^{\nu})$
wo das obere {+untere+} Zeichen für ein gerades {+ungerades+} $\mu-\lambda$ gilt.

methods.what: Basic three-term recursion for Euler continuants (each bracket is built from the two preceding ones)
General splitting formula for a continuant at an arbitrary index λ
Special cases of the cross-product identity for continuants
General cross-product (determinant-type) identity for continuants, with sign depending on the parity of μ−λ

items.english: Generally, (a^0...a^μ)(a^λ...a^ν) − (a^0...a^ν)(a^λ...a^μ) = ±(a^0...a^{λ-2})(a^{μ+2}...a^ν), where the upper (lower) sign holds for an even (odd) μ−λ.
